architecture_contract.accessibility_encoder: A convolutional stem with 2-fold max pooling followed by two convolutional blocks with 4-fold pooling reduces the 131072-position, 4-bp ATAC input to 4096 positions at 128-bp resolution.
architecture_contract.attention: Eight linear-scaling SNNK/Performer-style attention blocks with rotary positional embeddings
architecture_contract.sequence_encoder: A convolutional stem plus six convolution/softmax-pooling blocks reduce the 524288-bp one-hot sequence to 4096 positions.
architecture_contract.trans_context: 693-dimensional per-cell-context global motif-enrichment vector derived with SEA from Vierstra et al. 2020 consensus motifs

pretrained_atac.member_relationship: Two independently trained models used together for the paper's caQTL analysis; their seeds, run names, tensor manifests and ordering require archive inventory.

checkpoint_release.weight_format: Expected TensorFlow checkpoint bundles from the released restoration code, but exact files and schemas are unresolved until safe archive inventory.

accessibility.target_leakage_rule: For any masked-accessibility endpoint, all scored positions and their prespecified mask span must be removed from the ATAC input before inference. Unmasked target ATAC cannot be passed through as context.

global_motif_context.normalization: Per-cell-type SEA motif enrichments followed by the native relative scaling and released training means/standard deviations. Exact parity must be established from a frozen peak-set pipeline.

input_contract.topology_rule: ATAC and any RNA target must be labeled with their actual topology. EpiBERT fine-tuning mixed exact donor pairs with same-tissue datasets; same tissue cannot be upgraded to same donor or same aliquot.

license_audit.code_finding: The v1.0.0 GitHub/Zenodo code release is MIT licensed.
license_audit.derivative_weight_rule: CC-BY-4.0 permits adaptation and redistribution with attribution, but the archive must be checked for included notices and third-party components before release.
license_audit.weight_finding: Zenodo record 14504049 explicitly labels the model archive CC-BY-4.0.

native_scoring_contract.caQTL: Center a 1536-bp ATAC mask on the variant, predict REF and ALT in forward and reverse-complement orientations with each of the two pretraining checkpoints, restore orientation, take ALT-minus-REF over the central four 128-bp bins, then average strands and members. Exact released indices and member ordering must be reproduced from fixed fixtures before use.
native_scoring_contract.common_lane: The model cannot enter a sequence-only or RNA-context common lane under its native identity. Any ATAC-free or motif-free ablation is a separately named adaptation with the identical downstream head and input budget.
native_scoring_contract.member_uncertainty: The two checkpoints and two orientations are correlated technical predictions, not biological replicates. Preserve member outputs for stability diagnostics only.
native_scoring_contract.rampage: Use the fine-tuned checkpoint's central 896 bins. RNA/RAMPAGE outputs are an expression proxy and are not automatically comparable to signed donor-level eQTL or ieQTL effects.

fine_tuned_rampage.rna_head: softplus RAMPAGE coverage at 128-bp resolution over the central 114688 bp
fine_tuned_rampage.target_scale: Native normalized RAMPAGE and ATAC scales; exact inverse transform and strand/TSS aggregation require fixture validation.

pretraining_contract.cell_context_split: 738 training, 17 validation and 17 test ATAC contexts in the final paper; 34 cell types were held out across validation and test.
pretraining_contract.genomic_split: 34021 training, 2160 validation and 1840 reported test 524-kb windows, constructed to avoid overlap and reduce sequence similarity using Enformer-aligned approximately 1-Mb components.
pretraining_contract.masking: Approximately 15 percent of ATAC in random 1536-bp spans
pretraining_contract.rampage_finetuning: 50 training and 8 held-out ATAC-RAMPAGE contexts; some measurements were exact donor pairs and some only same-tissue matches.
pretraining_contract.training_data_manifest_status: PARTIAL: cell-context labels and genomic split files are released, but an exact accession/run/donor alias table bound to each checkpoint is not.

reference_contract.benchmark_rule: Regenerate all inputs from the project reference only after primary-contig parity, contig naming, coordinate, strand, REF-allele and window-boundary fixtures pass. Patch and haplotype scaffolds absent from training are out of domain.

runtime_contract.paper_compute: TPU v3-64; pretraining reported approximately 4.5 days
runtime_contract.requirements_lock_status: requirements.txt is a pip freeze-style environment capture, not a tested project lock for current CUDA GPUs

safe_loading_contract.archive_inventory: After campaign approval, verify the Zenodo MD5 and computed SHA-256; reject absolute paths, parent traversal, symlinks, hardlinks, device nodes, duplicate normalized names and decompression-limit violations before extraction.
safe_loading_contract.checkpoint_restore: Inventory TensorFlow variable names, shapes and dtypes without executing arbitrary archive content. Restore into the exact v1.0.0 architecture and require consumed/existing-object assertions; reject partial restores.
safe_loading_contract.numeric_parity: Reproduce fixed pretraining ATAC, RAMPAGE and two-member caQTL predictions in both orientations before admission.

source_evidence: The Cell Genomics article, official EpiBERT v1.0.0 repository, Zenodo code/model records and released small text/split/config files were queried on 2026-08-22. No checkpoint archive was downloaded or opened.

task_fit.rna_conditioned_atac: not_supported: EpiBERT consumes observed ATAC to reconstruct masked ATAC. It cannot infer ATAC from RNA alone and must not receive held-out target ATAC outside a prespecified mask.
task_fit.unified_model: eligible only as an observed-ATAC regulatory component after member inventory, parity and topology gates; it is not the requested RNA-context encoder
task_fit.variant_to_regulation: conditional diagnostic: native scoring targets accessibility/caQTL effects and requires observed context-specific ATAC. The RAMPAGE model may yield expression-proxy deltas, but neither output is inherently a signed donor-level eQTL/ieQTL effect.
